shots.detail_en: CH stands on the night rooftop where his father fell, flipping open the hand-drawn candlestick notebook as wind lifts its pages.
shots.sub: 饵是给我的——那钩呢？
shots.speaker: 长虹

shots.detail_en: CH inks a fishhook shape onto the tail of the Lianhua Yongsheng candlestick line in the notebook.
shots.sub: 饵在水里，钩在线上——线头，埋在十年前。
shots.speaker: 长虹（画外）

shots.detail_en: CH overlooks the Ganghai nightscape from the rooftop, the Lianhua Tower glowing deep among the neon.
shots.sub: 顺着钩往回摸，摸到 1993 那根线头——本金，就是我的探针。
shots.speaker: 旁白

shots.detail_en: CH crosses the crowded old trading hall toward the counter under the red-green flip board.
shots.sub: 联华永盛又疯了！七天七板！
shots.speaker: 散户甲

shots.detail_en: RED slides a hand-drawn funding-structure sheet across the counter and leans in with a warning.
shots.sub: 这盘的钱一层套一层——这口井，三年淹死过三个人。
shots.speaker: 红利
shots.fx: 计算器按键+环境音压低

shots.detail_en: Close-up of the sheet: arrows of money all draining into a hand-drawn well at its center.
shots.sub: 最底下那笔钱，账龄很深——深得反常。
shots.speaker: 红利

shots.detail_en: CH folds the sheet shut and meets RED's worried gaze across the counter.
shots.sub: 这不是学费，是买命钱！查案要交学费——这学费，我交得起。
shots.speaker: 红利／长虹

shots.detail_en: CH pushes his tie knot snug to his throat, the habit locked in since 1993.
shots.sub: 明知山有虎。我不是去打虎——我是去查它的户口。
shots.speaker: 长虹

shots.detail_en: MANCANG leans halfway out of the crowd, hushed by CH's raised hand.
shots.sub: 老大，风大，记得穿雨衣啊……
shots.speaker: 满仓

shots.detail_en: CH fills in a small entry order, the pen pausing once before it presses down.
shots.sub: 探针要细——动静越小，钩咬得越稳。
shots.speaker: 旁白

shots.detail_en: CH's trade confirmation prints out as one block of the flip board snaps red.
shots.sub: 入局了。
shots.speaker: 旁白

shots.detail_en: Cross-cut: CH pockets the slip while a blood-red tag reading PREY ENTERED lights up across XIONGWEI's server-room screens.
shots.sub: 陆长虹。欢迎入场——你的每一次心跳，现在归我记录。
shots.speaker: 熊伟

shots.detail_en: XIONGWEI's rimless glasses mirror the red tag as one fingertip taps to the flip-board rhythm.
shots.sub: 人的反应，0.3 秒。够慢了。
shots.speaker: 熊伟

shots.detail_en: XIONG watches the same tag light up in the penthouse office, smiling as he rolls his prayer beads.
shots.sub: 自己走进来的人，市场从不高攀。它只是——收下贪婪的人。
shots.speaker: 熊天成

shots.detail_en: CH looks up at the climbing board without a flicker of chase in his eyes.
shots.sub: 鱼吃饵的时候，不能惊动钓鱼的人。
shots.speaker: 长虹

shots.detail_en: The demon stock's K-line climbs like a fever as the crowd surges, CH standing rooted and still.
shots.sub: 追啊！晚了哭去吧！它要的是我追——我偏慢半拍。
shots.speaker: 散户乙／长虹（画外）

shots.detail_en: Under the lamp the notebook page reads 'the hook aims at 1993', circled three times in red.
shots.sub: 线头，我摸到第一寸了。
shots.speaker: 长虹（画外）

shots.detail_en: After the close RED hurries to the rooftop doorway with copied ledger pages, standing shoulder to shoulder with CH in the wind.
shots.sub: 这层套里最老的那笔钱，我核了三遍——它像是从很旧的年代流过来的。
shots.speaker: 红利

shots.detail_en: CH slides the ledger page into the missing-page gap of his father's notebook, fitting it exactly.
shots.sub: 账是死的。钓鱼的人是活的——红利，帮我盯住井口。
shots.speaker: 长虹

shots.detail_en: CH writes one line in the notebook — I am in, now it is your turn to show yourself — then stares at the Lianhua Tower in the dark window.
shots.sub: 十年了。出来，见见我。
shots.speaker: 长虹

shots.detail_en: Black screen with the next-episode teaser card in white text.
shots.sub: 以身为饵，本金入局——井底的东西，今晚先睁了眼。
shots.speaker: 字幕
shots.card: 以身为饵，本金入局——井底的东西，今晚先睁了眼。
